first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person riding Vehicle A, with a reddish-brown head, light gray-white garment panels over the shoulders and back, and blue-green trousers visible on the lower body.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The motorcycle-like vehicle ridden by Person A, with a blocky beige and gray-green shell and a dust-and-smoke trail connected behind it.

entities.name: dust-and-smoke trail
entities.identification: An elongated trail of smoke and dust connected behind Vehicle A, comprising dark-gray rounded clumps, a gray-brown band-like section, and light-beige blocky sections.

entities.name: orange sandy ground
entities.identification: The warm orange-yellow ground occupying the middle and lower parts of the image, scattered with dark dots, short dash-like markings, and small oval-shaped marks.

entities.name: reddish-brown canyon wall
entities.identification: The reddish-brown wall extending across the upper background, with fine dark dots on its surface and an undulating dark olive-brown band along its lower edge.

entities.name: group of red-orange layered rock towers
entities.identification: A group of red-orange rock formations with light-colored horizontal wavy strata; part of the tower body of one rock formation is visible at the right edge in the first frame of this clip.

entities.name: group of gray-white dead trees
entities.identification: Two leafless, thick-branched dead trees, one tall and one short, with gray-white lit surfaces and dark-gray shaded surfaces.

entities.name: scattered rocks
entities.identification: Small reddish-brown and brown rocks on the sandy ground, including angular, rounded, and relatively flat shapes.

entities.name: distant reddish-brown small object
entities.identification: A low, small reddish-brown irregular clustered object near the foot of the wall, with short protrusions along its edges and a darker base.
